name: KBS Drama Special
description: Forget the existing one-act dramas! Short but impactive! KBS Drama Special presents high quality single episode dramas. Dramas are the broadcast content with the widest public appeal. KBS Drama Special will produce short dramas of far-reaching impact involving at times a serious social message, unique emotions or perspectives. It will stay abreast of modern viewership.

Spy Trader Kim Chul-soo's Recent Condition
The Angel of Death Comes With Purple High Heels
The Woman from the Olle Road

Behind the Scenes of the Seokyeong Sports Council Reform

The Memory in My Old Wallet
Nara's Rain
videos.overview: On a heavily rainy day, Na-Ra (Jung Eun-Chae) lost her beloved husband and Woo-Ki (Yoo Min-Kyu) lost his beloved father. Two years later, Na-Ra and Woo-Ki meet as a teacher and student at a high school. Since his father died on the rainy day, he is afraid of rain. Na-Ra tries to take care of Woo-Ki and they are able to console each other. Teachers and students at the school though, eye them suspiciously.

videos.title: Came to Me and Became a Star
My Dad is a Nude Model
The Taste of Curry
videos.overview: Tucked away in a corner of Hongdae, Seoul, South Korea is the curry restaurant "Cat's Restaurant" run by Yu-Mi. She doesn't have very many customers, but Yu-Mi tries to stay the course. One day, Yu-Mi's restaurant is vandalized and she notices a guy standing behind her. Yu-Mi ends up knocking him out with her groceries. When he wakes up, the guy is unable to remember his own name. Until he regains his memory, the man helps out at Yu-Mi's restaurant.

videos.title: First Birthday
videos.overview: Jeong-Suk holds a one year birthday party for her daughter. She invites her old college friends to her apartment for the party. Tension from their past soon simmers during the birthday celebration.

videos.title: Playing Games
videos.overview: Nearing the age of 40, Nam Gung-Sang (Kim C) is content with his bachelor life and working at his mid-level office job. He is particular about certain things and somewhat condescending towards those around him. Lee Eun-Hong (Woo Hee-Jin) works at the same comapny as Nam Gung-Sang and similar in age. After attending a funeral for a co-worker, they wake up in the same bed. Meanwhile, Nam Gung-Sang becomes interested in younger co-worker Yu Ji-A (Shin So-Yul).

videos.title: You're Pretty, Oh Manbok
videos.overview:
Oh Man-Bok (Kim Hyang-Gi) lives with her family which includes her father (Park Chul-Min), mother (Ra Mi-Ran), older sister (Na Hae-Ryung) and older brother (Shin Dong-Woo). Her family loves her and treats her with kindness, but Oh Man-Bok still yearns to meet her birth father. After her birth parents separated, her mother passed away from cancer and her adoptive parents have taken care of her since then.

One day, Oh Man-Bok watches a music competition TV program and realizes the song that is being performed is the same song her mother sang to her. During the show, the singer mentions that 10 years ago he met a guy in Chuncheon who wrote and performed the original song. After the original singer broke up with his love, he could no longer sing the song anymore and gave the song to him. Oh Man-Bok is convinced the original singer is her father.

videos.title: The Dirge Singer
videos.overview:
The dirge singer is paid to attend funerals and mourn for the dead. They are viewed as belonging to the lowest class. Yeon-Sim (Kim You-Jung) is brought up by her mother (Hwang Mi-Seon) to become a dirge singer like herself. Yeon-Sim refuses to follow in her mother's footsteps and cry for others. She flees to a home to become a gisaeng.

Yun-Su (Seo Jun-Young) was born out of wedlock and is only half a noble person. Because of his birth status, he can't attain the stature that his brother (Kim Dong-Yun) has. Yun-Su and Yeon-Sim meet at a delicate moment in their lives.

videos.title: I'm Dying Soon
videos.overview: After experiencing pain near his stomach area, Choi U-Jin (Oh Jung-Se) goes to see a doctor. He learns that he has pancreatic cancer and only 3 months to live. While stunned by the news, Choi U-Jin eventually decides to live the last 3 months of his life fully. He quits his job as an office worker, closes out his savings account and books a hotel suite for the next 3 months. Meanwhile, Sa-Rang (Kim Seul-Gi) worked with Choi U-Jin at his former office job and likes him a lot. In fact, she was the only woman who liked him there.

videos.title: The Reason I'm Getting Married
videos.overview:
Kim Ji-Won (Park Hee-Von) and Han Seung-Uk (Song Jong-Ho) have dated for about 6 years and they will get married in 3 months. Yet, their seems to be little excitement in their relationship Kim Ji-Won even asks Han Seung-Uk "Why are we getting married?"

One day, while Kim Ji-Won is getting fitted for a wedding dress, she meets Lee Jun-Gi (Hong Jong-Hyun). He had a huge crush on her in the past.

videos.title: Middle School Student A
videos.overview:
Lee Hae-Jun (Kwak Dong-Yeon) transfers to a new middle school in an affluent area of Seoul. At his previous school, Lee Hae-Jun was the top ranked student in his grade. While going to his first day of class at his new school, he sees a girl leaning over a bridge. Thinking she may jump, he pulls her to the ground which she does not appreciate. Later that day, Lae Hae-Jun learns the girl he saw earlier is Jo Eun-Seo (Lee Yul-Eum). She's currently the top ranked student at his new school.

3 months later, with new test scores released, Lee Hae-Jun takes the top spot and bumps Jo Eun-Seo down to #2. Meanwhile, Jo Eun-Seo vows that Lee Hae-Jun won't beat her again. She recruits her classmate Jeong Na-Yeon (Lee Han-Na) to help her retake the top spot. Lee Hae-Jun finds himself falling for Jo Eun-Seo.

videos.title: That Kind of Love
videos.overview: Heo Jin-Uk (Bae Soo-Bin) is serving a life in prison term. After years in prison, he is informed that he is terminally ill and he will be released from prison. For the past two years, he has been visited in prison by Ji Yeon-Su (Lee Yoon-Ji). She is part of a volunteer group that tries to help reform prisoners. Without having anywhere to go, Heo Jin-Uk visits Ji Yeon-Su. Her personal life is far different than what he envisioned.

videos.title: Youth
videos.overview: Seok-Ju (Seo Young-Joo) lives with his older brother Seok-Hyeon (Kim Heung-Soo). Seok-Hyeon was once a promising boxer, but he nows works at a market selling fish. Seok-Ju feels nothing but hopelessness with his situation. He sees an out when his older brother's former friend Jong-Beom (Um Tae-Goo) offers him a job to work with his gang. His older brother warns him to stay away from Jong-Beom.

videos.title: Illegal Parking
videos.overview: Noh Jung-Do (On Joo-Wan) is an office worker at a law firm. He buys a new car, to impress Lee Ji-Hyun (Jang Joon-Yoo). He carpools with her to work everyday. Anxiety soon sets in for Noh Jung-Do when a taxi company CEO (Kim Sang-Ho) parks in his spot everyday.

videos.title: The Dreamer
videos.overview: Joo Joon-Kil (Yang Jin-Woo) dreams about the deaths of others before it even happens. He drives out to see a client (Yoon Se-Ah) and meets the woman from his last dream. He can't help falling in love with her even though he keeps seeing her death in his dream.

videos.title: Pitch-black Darkness
videos.overview: Park Hyun-Tae (Danny Ahn) drives his bus through a tunnel like every other night, but this evening high school student Jung Woo-Min (Kang Chan) is standing outside of the tunnel. Park Hyun-Tae is unable to avoid the student and he is killed. When he goes back to work, he has to drive through the same tunnel every evening. Meanwhile, he overhears high school students mention Han Jung-Wook's (Kwak Jung-Wook) bullying as a reason for Jung Woo-Min committing suicide.

videos.title: Bomi's Room
videos.overview: Kong Bo-Mi (Ahn Seo-Hyun) ia miserable that she has to share a room with her older sister Kong Eun-Joo (Lee Young-Ah). Even though her mom (Park Hae-Mi) promised to renovate the storage room into a bedroom for Kong Bo-Mi, she realizes she will be stuck with her older sister forever. Kong Bo-Mi then gets the idea that if she can get her older sister married, the bedroom will be all hers.

videos.title: The End of that Summer
videos.overview: Han Soo-Kyung (Cho Eun-Sook) receives a phone call that her husband (Lee Kwang-Ki) was involved in a car accident and is now in coma.While filing insurance papers, Han Soo-Kyung learns that her husband registered a young boy Kim Cho-Rok (Jeon Jin-Seo) on their family register. Han Soo-Kyung goes through her husband's phone and contacts a woman from his recent caller list. They make plans to meet at a cafe in Chuncheon. There, Han Soo-Kyung meets the woman and young Kim Cho-Rok.

videos.title: The Three Female Runaways
videos.overview: Su-Ji, Kim Yeo-Jin and Hyung-Ja all converge at the park, while they are all being chased by men who want to take them back. They decide to escape together.

videos.title: The Girl Who Became A Photo
The Wind Blows to the Hope
What is the Ghost Up To?
Trains Don't Stop at Noryangjin Station
If We Were A Season
videos.overview: Born on the same day and raised side by side, high school students Yoon Hae-Rim and Uhm Ki-Seok are close friends. They never say it, but they are precious to each other. One day, a transfer student from Seoul comes. Oh Dong-Kyung is bold and not afraid to say what he is feeling, unlike Hae Rim and Ki Seok. Is Dong Keung enough to shake up their friendship?

videos.title: You Are Closer Than I Think
The Love of a Buzz Cut
Review Notebook of My Embarrassing Days
Home Sweet Home
videos.overview: Soo-A is an architectural designer. Her boyfriend Yoo-Chan proposes to her, but she tells a lie to him. What is the secret involving the house and her lie?

videos.title: Rural Outcasts
videos.overview: Soon-Ho has a dream, which other people should not know about. He moves to an abandoned house, located in a small country village. Soon-Ho happens to meet 12-year-old girl Dong-Ja .

videos.title: Wreck Car
videos.overview: Tae-Goo is a tow truck driver. One day, he witnesses a girl being kidnapped. Tae-Goo attempts to find the kidnapper to save the girl.

videos.title: The Pleasures and Sorrows of Work
The reason why I can't tell you
My Daughter / Hee-Soo
videos.overview: Joo-Eun and Tae-Hoon are married and they have a 6-year-old daughter named Hee-Soo. As working parents, they are busy, but enjoy happy times together. Their world suddenly changes when Hee-Soo dies in a car accident. Joo-Eun and Tae-Hoon experience tremendous grief over their loss. With the help of VR program developer Joon-Beom, Joo-Eun and Tae-Hoon meet Hee-Soo again through virtual reality.

videos.title: F20
videos.overview: Ae-ran, a proud mother, hears a shocking news that her son Do-hoon has developed schizophrenia. Afraid of losing her perfect daily life, Ae-ran decided to hide his son's illness, but her secret gradually turning her anxiety into madness.

videos.title: Scenery of Pain
videos.overview: In a shabby neighborhood where serial murders are disguised as lonely deaths occur, an elderly priest who hears the confession of a criminal and a middle-aged female detective work together to find and chase down the culprit.

videos.title: The Effect of a Finger Flick on a Breakup
videos.overview: A realistic romance about a woman who wants to be loved and a man who doesn’t know how to express love.

videos.title: The Palace
videos.overview: So-Ssang has been a court lady for the past 14 years. One day, she learns something about Kwon-Min, who is the concubine of Crown Prince Yi Hyang. Meanwhile, Kwon-Min wants to be the only person loved by Crown Prince Yi Hyang. For that, Kwon-Min needs to oust Crown Prince Yi Hyang’s wife Bong-Sun. So-Ssang is given a mission by Kwon-Min. Her assignment is to oust Bong-Sun.

videos.title: Atonement
videos.overview: A suspenseful thriller about three friends who live with the scars of a sexual crime. After 12 years, they reunite to seek revenge.

videos.title: Memories of Hae-Gak
videos.overview:
Eun-Soo (Moon Geun-Young) took care of her alcoholic husband Seok-Young (Jo Han-Sun) for 7 years. She became stressed over her harsh situation, including taking care of her husband and working a job to support them. Due to Eun-Soo's dedicated nursing, Seok-Young was able to break his alcohol addiction. But now, Eun-Soo has now become an alcoholic and Seok-Young takes care of her. He gets tired of their situation.

Meanwhile Hae-Gak (Kang Sang-Joon) is the owner of a rental cottage, located at the end of a beach. He understands alcoholic Eun-Soo’s pain.

videos.title: The Stain
videos.overview: A music college student who secretly practices piano at a junior's house to get an opportunity to study abroad runs into a catastrophe when he encounters an unexpected guest.

videos.title: Currently Offline
videos.overview: A poor 26-year-old rider has great dreams, but reality is harsh. He ends up with special powers strong enough to kill someone and punishes the bad. A story about the birth of a young dark hero.

videos.title: Prism
videos.overview: A beautiful and lonely story of growth about high school students who dreamed of being ballet dancers at a young age, finding the meaning of life through each other, suffering and badly hurting each other.

videos.title: Nineteen Otters
videos.overview: The story of the precarious and affectionate first love of a 19-year-old who carries around a letter of resignation.

videos.title: Let's Meet in an Unfamiliar Season
videos.overview: A drama that tells the story of COVID-19-confirmed patients in 2020 who enter a residential treatment center, communicating through windows and comforting each other during unfamiliar and fearful quarantine times.

videos.title: Underwear Season
videos.overview: A story about a young man who doesn't believe in sincerity meets Don Quixote, the president of an underwear company, and his right-hand man, Sancho, and becomes sincere both in underwear and in life.

videos.title: Do You Know Ashtanga?
videos.overview: A yoga instructor with a twisted mind meets a sugar daddy in this bumpy human romantic comedy.

videos.title: Silence of the Lambs
videos.overview: A drama about the conflict between Captain Choi Hyeong Won, who has to silence a case to seize the last chance of promotion.

videos.title: Devil in the Lake
videos.overview: A horror movie that takes place against the background of a reservoir where people are dying.

videos.title: The Distributors
videos.overview: Yoo-bin, a man who dreams of a happy married life, is led by his old friend, Sang-bum, and spends an unforgettable day at the club. And then, the memories from before that night disappeared, and a phone call was received from someone. The criminal said that if he didn't get 33 million won, he would release the video to the world... Tonight, everything he wanted to hide is unlocked.

videos.title: No Path Back
videos.overview: A story about a salesman in beverage distribution who makes the wrong decision to better his life.

videos.title: Half Lies
videos.overview: The story of 10-year-old Du-ri, who lied to hide her parents' divorce, and the growth of people around her trying to protect Du-ri.

videos.title: Shoot For Love
videos.overview: Do-hyun was a promising youth soccer player in the national team but retired due to injury. Growing up in an orphanage, she leaves the facility, turning 20. While bending over backward to stand on her own, Do-hyun meets an amateur female futsal team and becomes a proper adult. Now, Do-hyun wants to confess her feelings to her first love, Moo-won.

videos.title: Anyone Anywhere
videos.overview: Eun-ho goes to school early in the morning as usual and senses something is odd. To school where it should still be silent, the police and ambulance have come. While things are hectic, a lonely little hand drops lethargically from the stretcher. The estimated time of death was 11:13 p.m. last night. It was 45 minutes before the victim's birthday, and on that day, we were there.

videos.title: Dog Days of Summer
videos.overview: Puberty causes emotional turmoil and secondary sex characteristics to appear. During this stage, teenagers go through their own pain, which leads some to fully transform while some don't. In this process of becoming another version of themselves, puberty hits like a midsummer heatwave that burns the teenagers swept in chaos. This is a story about teenagers who accept the changes puberty causes and grow one step at a time.

videos.title: The True Love of Madam
videos.overview: Seol-ae is known for her humble life style as the wife of Jung-yeol, the man of integrity. However, her beauty and elegance can't be unnoticed. Also, as she grew up as the dotted youngest daughter, she still has a child in her. After Jung-yeol was dismissed, they moved to a small town, but as Jung-yeol stops being intimate with her, Seol-ae spends a lonely and agonizing nights. Meanwhile, after seeing a servant boy taking a bath at the valley, half-naked, Seol-ae opens up to a new possibility.

videos.title: Behind the Shadows
videos.overview: It features a gay storyline set in the Joseon Dynasty and explores the complexities of love, friendship, and social conventions. Yoon Ho, Jae Woon, and Seol were childhood friends who hung out together before their coming-of-age ceremony. However, their friendship intertwines through love, as one day, Yoon Ho realizes that his heart is pounding for someone, leading him to develop his first love that he can't tell anyone about. The youthful romance set in Joseon begins.

videos.title: Love Attack
videos.overview: A campus drama about what happens when Cha Seok-jin, second-rank in the school, attacks with confession to blur the concentration of Kang Kyeong-joo, an ace.

videos.title: Overlap Knife, Knife
videos.overview: A story about two people trying to protect their loved ones by turning back time and confronting fate.

videos.title: The History of Us
videos.overview: The story of a young officer who tries to stop the crown prince from erasing history in order to become king.

videos.title: Find Handsome!
videos.overview: A story about Cutie, an unknown idol who dreams of making a comeback, and his journey to find Handsome, a missing former member of the disbanded group.

videos.title: The Two Women
videos.overview: A story of a husband battle that unfolds in a village near the 38th parallel a year before the outbreak of the Korean War.

videos.title: The Road in Between
videos.overview: The story of Seo Hu, a member of the Road View filming team who went through a painful breakup, and Eun Ha, who searches for her father who was caught on Road View, stumbles her way through the path of separation and entering the alley of love.

videos.title: To My Lonely Sister
videos.overview: Unfolds as Ha Neul, a high school girl with a reclusive, lonely older sister, begins a plan to help her sister escape from her room. With the theme of love and recovery between families, it depicts the process in which the Ha Neul overcomes her family's pain together.
